name: Matrix Hair Seum 100ml Opti Care Smooth Straight Professional Split End Hair Serum with Shea Butter for All Hair Types - Paraben Free
description:
Matrix Opti Care Smooth Straight Professional Hair Serum – 100ml
With Shea Butter | Split End Repair | For All Hair Types | Paraben-Free

Origin: Made in India 🇮🇳

Key Benefits:

Light, non-greasy formula that smooths frizz & tames flyaways

Protects against split end damage & repairs frayed tips

Leaves hair silky, soft, and with a reflective shine

Maintains straightened effect for up to 72 washes (when used with Opti Care Shampoo + Conditioner + Serum & monthly Hair Treatment)

Enriched with Shea Butter for deep nourishment

Trusted by professional hair stylists worldwide

Suggested Use:

Shake well before use

Rub a small amount into your hands

Apply on dry or damp hair, focusing on the ends and working towards the scalp

Style as desired
